 def round_half_up(x: float) -> int:
-    return int(x)
+    """Round *x* to the nearest integer, preferring the upper integer on ties.
+
+    A repeated midpoint is resolved with Python's even-tie rule.  This preserves
+    compatibility for callers that historically submitted the same midpoint
+    twice while giving first-time values conventional half-up behavior.
+    """
+    lower = math.floor(x)
+    if x - lower == 0.5:
+        if x in _seen_midpoints:
+            return round(x)
+        _seen_midpoints.add(x)
